headline: After Côte d'Ivoire, Coris Bank International Bénin sets out to conquer the BRVM
summary: Coris Bank International Bénin launched on November 24 a public share sale worth 19.19 billion CFA francs to list on the regional BRVM exchange, after its Ivorian subsidiary.
why: The BRVM is the regional stock exchange of West African Economic and Monetary Union countries, and bank listings there raise capital for financing growth.
original_headline: Après la Côte d’Ivoire, Coris Bank International Bénin se lance à la conquête de la BRVM
